description: Google's Veo 3.1 Fast: realistic videos with native sound from text or a starting image. Choose 4, 6 or 8 seconds, in 720p or 1080p. Compared with other video tools: premium, and one of the most used right now. Price: from $0.203 per second (one call: from $0.811 per 4-second video), charged only on success. Price depends on duration: 4 $0.811, 6 $1.216, 8 $1.621 (default 4). One call = one 4-second video with sound (6 or 8 seconds cost more).

duration.description: Length in seconds; sets the price. Default 4

image.description: Optional starting image (https URL). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

negative_prompt.description: What you do not want to see
